description: This file defines a Fragment class ContactDetailFragment for an Android application. It displays detailed information for a specific contact, including photo, name, and addresses, and supports loading via cursors. It handles contact image loading asynchronously, builds address views, and interacts with the Android Contacts Content Provider.

classes.name: ContactDetailFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment class that displays detailed contact information, manages loading data with CursorLoaders, handles image loading asynchronously, and builds address layouts.

classes.name: ContactDetailQuery
classes.description: Constants used for querying main contact details from the Contacts Content Provider.

classes.name: ContactAddressQuery
classes.description: Constants used for querying address details of a contact from the Contacts Content Provider.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of the fragment with a specified contact Uri.

methods.name: setContact
methods.description: Sets or clears the contact to be displayed, initiates data loading or clears views if null.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initial setup of the fragment, including resource checks and image loader configuration.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout and initializes key view references.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Initializes contact data after activity creation.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu actions, such as editing the contact.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates menu options and manages visibility based on contact state.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates CursorLoader instances for contact details and addresses.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Processes loaded data, updates the UI with contact name and addresses.

methods.name: buildEmptyAddressLayout
methods.description: Creates a layout indicating no address was found.

methods.name: buildAddressLayout
methods.description: Builds a view for a contact address, including view map button functionality.

methods.name: constructGeoUri
methods.description: Constructs a geo: URI for mapping an address.

methods.name: getLargestScreenDimension
methods.description: Returns the maximum of screen width and height for image sizing.

methods.name: loadContactPhoto
methods.description: Loads the contact photo asynchronously, handling different platform versions.
